title: Link Buka halaman riset di email draf riset / Open-research-page link in research-draft email
summary: ID: Email Draf riset siap direview kini menyisipkan link Buka halaman riset (/id/konten/riset/{id}) di atas link review. / EN: The research-draft-ready email now inserts an Open research page link (/id/konten/riset/{id}) above the review link.
problem_before: ID: Email hanya menautkan halaman review; penerima tak bisa lompat langsung ke halaman riset sesi terkait. / EN: The email only linked the review page; recipients could not jump straight to the related session research page.
solution: ID: Input sendDraftReadyEmail tambah field opsional researchSessionId; body HTML sisipkan paragraf tautan riset sebelum paragraf review; runner meneruskan sessionId yang sudah ada di scope. / EN: Added an optional researchSessionId field to the sendDraftReadyEmail input; the HTML body inserts the research link paragraph before the review paragraph; the runner passes the already-in-scope sessionId.
reason: ID: Mempercepat navigasi admin dari notifikasi email ke konteks riset penuh. / EN: Speeds admin navigation from the email notification to full research context.
user_impact: ID: Email memuat 2 link berurutan: riset lalu review; email test tanpa sessionId tetap valid (link riset absen). / EN: Emails carry 2 ordered links: research then review; test emails without a sessionId stay valid (research link absent).
tech_impact: ID: Field opsional sehingga pemanggil lama (email test automation) tak perlu diubah. / EN: Optional field so existing callers (automation test email) need no change.
